data.name: Station Haven 3: What Remains
data.detailed_description:
Station Haven 3: What Remains is a first-person horror game where you will be playing as the newest crew member aboard the Station Haven 3.

As you wake up to the growing sound of an engine, you find yourself aboard a Pod that's about to arrive at Station Haven 3. With no recollection of how you got there in the first place, or even who you are, you unwillingly step onto the Station.

Where is everyone?

Uncover the mystery of the crew's vanishing aboard the station. Find their audio logs, uncover their story, live through their memories and piece together the truth.

Maintain the ship's usability.

As you uncover the secrets of the Station, you must make sure that it maintains full usability. By using the Terminal aboard the Station, figure out what section of the ship requires your attention and fix the issue before it's too late.

Uncover the secrets of the Station, find out what happened to the crew and to you.

Who sent you here? Why were you sent here? Who even are you? Slowly piece together what remains aboard the station to figure out what has happened.

Find a way to escape.

Will you be able to find a way to get back home? Will you be able to remember who you are? Or will the Station swallow you whole like it did many times before?

data.short_description: Following the largest cybernetic breach in history, classified documents have exposed an unclaimed Station drifting in Mars' orbit. The crew can't be reached, yet something else now resides there. Every three months, we send someone there. This time, you're the lucky winner.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Quad-Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These requirements are currently temporary and will be updated accordingly. Especially the Disk Space.

  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz Quad-Core CPU
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 6-8 GB RAM
